grammar.explanation: Homeric Greek is an artificial literary dialect combining Ionic, Aeolic, and archaic features. It preserves forms lost in classical Attic and employs formulaic language reflecting oral composition.

readingPassage.greek: Μῆνιν ἄειδε, θεά, Πηληϊάδεω Ἀχιλῆος οὐλομένην...
readingPassage.analysis: Πηληϊάδεω: genitive in -εω (Ionic) rather than -ου. θεά: vocative to the Muse. Oral formulaic style: μῆνιν announces theme immediately.

exercises.question: What dialect features appear in: τὸν δ᾽ ἀπαμειβόμενος προσέφη πόδας ὠκὺς Ἀχιλλεύς
exercises.answer: Formula: πόδας ὠκὺς Ἀχιλλεύς (epithet). Line-type: speech introduction formula.
